recipes.title: Egg & Sausage Breakfast Bits
recipes.prep_notes:
Cook the sausage till brown.
Mix the eggs in a mixing bowl with seasonings and half&half or milk.
Place sausage in 24 Muffin tin.
Fill the tops with egg.
Place the cheese on the top.
Cook in Muffin Tin at 375° for 15-18 minutes
